Name: SWORD_ARTS_PARAM_ST
Description: Defines weapon skills. A weapon's skill is the fitted Ash of War's Skill ID when it has an Ash of War, otherwise the weapon's own Sword Arts Param ID. The skill's animations are the a(600 + Sword Arts Type) section of the character's TAE; most of a skill's behaviour lives in those animations, the behaviour script and BehaviorParam.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Development flag for network-test builds. Not read by the retail game.
Padding.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Skill Speed Type
Fields.Description: Value handed to the behaviour script (HKS env 121) for the skill of the given hand. Per the developer notes it picks the skill's cancel timing: 0 normal (left-hand attack), 1 early, 2 slow. Retail: 1 or 2 on every skill.

Fields.Name: Use Right-hand Skill in Left Hand
Fields.Description: When the weapon with this skill is in the left hand and neither weapon is two-handed, the right-hand weapon's skill is used instead (for animations and the skill shown in the HUD). Retail: on for most weapon skills, off for shield, bow and a few left-hand skills.

Fields.Name: Grey Out in Left Hand
Fields.Description: Greys out the HUD skill name when this skill comes from the left-hand weapon (one-handed, not using the right-hand skill).

Fields.Name: Grey Out in Right Hand
Fields.Description: Greys out the HUD skill name when this skill is used from the right-hand weapon while one-handed (via Use Right-hand Skill in Left Hand). Retail: only Torch Attack.

Fields.Name: Grey Out When Two-handed
Fields.Description: Greys out the HUD skill name while the weapon with this skill is two-handed. Retail: only Torch Attack.
Padding.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Skill name (Skill Title FMG), shown in the HUD and in weapon and Ash of War menus.

Fields.Name: FP Cost: L1
Fields.Description: FP cost of the skill when used with L1. The cost is multiplied by the active SpEffects' Skill FP Consumption % and rounded up. Retail: −1 on every skill.

Fields.Name: FP Cost: L2
Fields.Description: FP cost of the skill's main use (L2). The cost is multiplied by the active SpEffects' Skill FP Consumption % and rounded up. The skill counts as short of FP when current FP is 0 or below half the cost. The HUD and menus show this cost (the HUD marks the skill when FP is below half of it); when it is 0 or less they show the lower positive one of R1/R2. −1: not used (retail).

Fields.Name: FP Cost: R1
Fields.Description: FP cost of a skill use or follow-up on R1 (for example bow skills, stance follow-ups). Scaled and checked like FP Cost: L2. −1: not used (retail).

Fields.Name: FP Cost: R2
Fields.Description: FP cost of a skill use or follow-up on R2. Scaled and checked like FP Cost: L2. −1: not used (retail).

Fields.Name: Shield Icon Type
Fields.Description: Older regulation layout only: replaced by Sword Arts Type. Not read by the current game.
Padding (older regulation layout).

Fields.Name: Sword Arts Type
Fields.Description: Animation section of the skill: its animations are a(600 + value)_xxxxxx in the character's TAE. Retail: 0–399 (a600–a999), 255 for No Skill; mostly unique per skill.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Skill icon shown in the HUD. Retail: 0 on many skills.

Fields.Name: AI Usage ID
Fields.Description: Value returned to AI scripts by GetAIUsageParam for this skill; the scripts use it to decide when to use the skill. Its meaning is script-defined. −1: none.
